rule.Restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.
rule.Title: VOWED TARGET
rule.Text:
At the start of your Movement phase, select one of the following:
▪ Defensive Footing: Select one objective you control. Until the start of your next Movement phase, that objective is your Vowed objective.
▪ Aggressive Push: Select one or more objective you do not control. Until the start of your next Movement phase, each of those objectives is one of your Vowed objectives. If a rule refers to a unit or model being within range of your Vowed objective, that rule takes effect if that unit or model is within range of one or more of your Vowed objectives. Each time a Deathwing Infantry unit from your army makes an attack that targets a unit within range of one or more of your Vowed objectives, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.Name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.Category: INNER CIRCLE TASK FORCE - BATTLE TACTIC STRATAGEM
stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.Target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.Effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.Name: Martial Mastery
stratagems.Category: INNER CIRCLE TASK FORCE - EPIC DEED STRATAGEM
stratagems.Target: One Deathwing Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.Effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.Name: Duty Unto Death
stratagems.Category: INNER CIRCLE TASK FORCE - STRATEGIC PLOY STRATAGEM
stratagems.When: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.Target: One Deathwing unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.Effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.Name: Relic Teleportarium
stratagems.Category: INNER CIRCLE TASK FORCE - STRATEGIC PLOY STRATAGEM
stratagems.Target: One Deathwing unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.Effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.
stratagems.Restrictions: Until the end of the turn your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.Name: Wrath of the Lion
stratagems.Category: INNER CIRCLE TASK FORCE - EPIC DEED STRATAGEM
stratagems.Target: One Deathwing Infantry unit from your army that just ended a Charge mode.
stratagems.Effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each model in your unit, adding 1 to the result if that enemy unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker; for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 3 mortal wounds).

stratagems.Name: Unmatched Fortitude
stratagems.Category: INNER CIRCLE TASK FORCE - BATTLE TACTIC STRATAGEM
stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.Target: One Deathwing Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking units attacks.
stratagems.Effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than your units Toughness characteristic, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.Name: Champion of the Deathwing
enhancements.Description: Deathwing model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [LETHAL HITS] ability, and each time the bearer makes a melee attach, if it is within range of your Vowed objective marker, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

enhancements.Name: Eye of the Unseen
enhancements.Description: Deathwing model only. Each time you target the bearer's unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if the bearer is within range of your Vowed objective marker, on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.Name: Singular Will
enhancements.Description: Deathwing model only. Each time th bearer's unit Piles In or Consolidates, models in that unit can move an additional 3".

enhancements.Name: Deathwing Assault
enhancements.Description: Deathwing model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer's unit can be setup using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

inventoryExceptions: 6 Inner Circle Companions : exception structurante, car ils donnent a Azrael une unite Deathwing mobile et dense sans consommer une seconde brique Terminator.
strictLoss: La variante stricte remplace exactement les six Inner Circle Companions par six Bladeguard Veterans. Elle conserve 2 000 points, mais Azrael perd un accompagnement naturellement Deathwing et la liste devient moins fluide autour de l'objectif jure.

scenarioPlans.thesis: Gagner la majorite par vagues : construire deux objectifs solides, puis rendre instable le troisieme objectif adverse.
scenarioPlans.support: Un objectif que les Deathwing peuvent rejoindre en deux couches, couvert par un angle de Hellblasters ou de char.
scenarioPlans.preserve: une brique Deathwing, les Scouts de releve et au moins une source de tir lourd
scenarioPlans.first: Declarer un objectif jure defendable et montrer une seule couche; garder l'autre hors de la reponse immediate.
scenarioPlans.second: Laisser l'adversaire reveler son operateur, puis designer l'objectif qui transforme la contre-attaque Deathwing en reprise.
scenarioPlans.lesson: L'objectif jure doit organiser le tour; il ne doit jamais devenir une obligation de charger une cible sans valeur de mission.
rounds: R1 : mesurer les axes, proteger les operateurs et refuser l'exposition simultanee des couches.
R2 : engager une seule ressource offensive et conserver une releve a distance de la reponse adverse.
R3 : remplacer la premiere couche usee, puis choisir si le centre ou un flanc devient la priorite.
R4 : attribuer des maintenant chaque unite survivante au primaire, a une secondaire ou a la bascule finale.
R5 : compter l'OC et les positions legales avant les dommages; la derniere unite mobile ne poursuit pas une cible secondaire.
scenarioPlans.abort: Si operateur, releve et soutien peuvent etre touches par la meme reponse, reduire l'ambition et reconstruire la profondeur.
scenarioPlans.fallback: Tenir deux positions, nettoyer l'unite qui produit le double rendement adverse et reporter l'activation de score plutot que l'annoncer acquise.
scenarioPlans.secondary: Confier la carte a l'unite la moins structurante. Une Scout ou une petite unite mobile porte l'Action laterale; la brique centrale ne quitte le primaire que si les deux objectifs se superposent vraiment.
scenarioPlans.setup: Au debut du round 3 de Secure Asset, l'adversaire peut contester l'objectif cle avec une unite ecran et garde sa piece de contre-attaque en retrait.
scenarioPlans.decision: Envoyer la piece la plus puissante maintenant, ou retirer l'ecran avec une couche secondaire avant de basculer ?
scenarioPlans.a: Si le nettoyage ouvre l'objectif sans exposer la releve, utiliser le tir ou la petite vague, puis conserver la brique principale pour la reprise.
scenarioPlans.b: Si la cible restera contestee ou si le contre-jeu prend deux couches a la fois, tenir la position, ecranter et reporter la bascule.
